notes: Copilot CLI preToolUse payload captured live (Copilot CLI 1.0.80, headless -p with GITHUB_COPILOT_PROMPT_MODE_REPO_HOOKS=true). Exit 2: denied, but stderr is dropped and the model only sees "hook exited with code 2" - which is why the maister hook uses exit 0 + deny JSON on Copilot. The class fired 3 times; every invocation is kept, one JSON object per line. platform_outcome documents what the harness did, not what the maister hook decides.
